Definition: to place; in transitively, to be placed
BiblicalUsage: Yâsam means to place, to set something where it belongs. Meat was set before Abraham's servant before he would eat, and Joseph's body was put in a coffin in Egypt after he died.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God places every life and every death, and Joseph's coffin waited in Egypt for the exodus.
